message.content:
An editorial illustration shows a tall, upright structure in the center, combining architectural and biological features. The lower two-thirds of the object has the texture and color of brown crocodile skin, with short, clawed limbs extending from its sides and back. The top portion of the object is a grey building with vertical ridges and a flat roof. A large crocodile head, textured with scales and teeth, opens wide around the building. The open mouth reveals a red band encircling the grey structure.

The red band features the white word “AMBYAR...” in bold, capital letters. Below it, several lines of smaller white text are visible: “JENDERAL POLISI AKTIF”, “MULAI BERTUGAS”, “SEBAGAI KETUA KOMISI”, “PEMBERANTASAN”, “KORUPSI. INILAH AKHIR”, “KISAH CICAK VERSUS”, and “BUAYA.” 

The top of the image contains black text: “POLISI BRUTAL DI TAMANSARI” on the left and “SKEMA TARIF ENERGI TERBARUKAN” on the right. At the bottom left, a white box contains a barcode, numbers, and the date “23-29 DESEMBER 2019”. The background is a hazy, off-white sky.
